content: Noise XX on .NET: recommend hand-rolling the XX state machine (spec rev33) over NSec.Cryptography 26.4.0 primitives, validated against cacophony vectors; whatsmeow itself hand-rolls Noise (handshake.go, no noise dep in go.mod). Noise.NET 1.0.0 (Metalnem, MIT) rejected: dormant since 2020-12-26, netstandard1.3, pins stale native libsodium 1.0.16 package that collides with NSec bundled libsodium. Torann 0.2.0 immature (370 downloads). Sources GitHub API Metalnem/noise + tulir/whatsmeow, NuGet search. Confidence MEDIUM-HIGH (spike should confirm).
